title: Operational playbook for compliance rollouts and rollback scenarios
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Create an operational playbook that codifies milestone gating, pre-flight checks, evidence collection, and explicit rollback scenarios for compliance-sensitive releases (SOC2/ISO controls, SSO/SAML enforcement, audit-log retention changes). This ticket captures the runbook, validation automation, stakeholder matrix, and test cases needed to gate production rollouts and to execute safe rollbacks when controls or observability regressions are detected.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned runbook hosted in Confluence with step-by-step gating checklist for SOC2/ISO-related features
Automated pre-release validation (CI job) that verifies audit log ingestion and KMS encryption are functioning for the target environment
SSO enforcement plan with phased windows and a customer opt-out path documented
Rollback procedures with paging contacts, automated feature-flag revert, and telemetry thresholds for trigger
Evidence packaging script that collects required artifacts (logs, screenshots, policy docs) and writes to the evidence bucket for audit reviewers
progress_updates: 2025-02-18: Ticket created after initial scoping with security and infra. Identified core owners and initial list of dependent engineering tickets.
2025-02-21: Draft checklist for SSO enforcement windows completed; added staged enforcement (pilot -> org opt-in -> full enforcement). Assigned ENG-48210 to implement opt-out flag.
2025-02-25: Met with Applied ML and Infra to define audit-log schema and retention buckets. Decided on three retention tiers (30d / 1y / 7y) tied to customer contract class.
2025-02-28: Prototype evidence packaging script uploaded to GH PR #7784; needs security review and CI integration for redaction rules.

2025-03-03: Finalized rollback triggers: increase in auth failure rate >1.5x baseline for 5m OR >2% error responses in SSO flow for 10m. Added fallback route to hosted verification endpoint. Currently drafting Confluence runbook sections for on-call and exec escalation.
decisions: Use phased SSO enforcement starting with a 50-org pilot (two-week observation) before organization-wide enforcement
Audit log retention will be configurable per-customer with default tier mapping based on contract class; minimum evidentiary retention for SOC2 will be 1 year
Automated evidence collection will redact PII and upload signed manifests to the encrypted evidence bucket (KMS-managed keys)
Rollback will prefer feature-flag reversion + traffic routing to a compatible fallback model rather than immediate infra rollback to reduce blast radius
risks: Insufficient telemetry coverage may cause false-positive rollbacks; need to add more SLO-oriented metrics before full enforcement
Evidence automation could miss edge-case logs from legacy agents; requires a compatibility test matrix
Customer experience risk for orgs on older SAML providers — need documented fallback and manual support flow
Tight timeline may increase operational load for on-call during pilot windows
next_steps: Finalize Confluence runbook and circulate for security review by 2025-03-10
Merge evidence packaging PR and add CI job to run redaction checks (owner: ENG-48210)
Schedule pilot cohort (50 orgs) and set monitoring dashboard + alert thresholds for rollback triggers
Prepare customer communication template and self-serve opt-out guide for SSO enforcement
Run tabletop exercise with on-call, security, and support teams to validate rollback playbook by 2025-03-20
notes: This playbook is intentionally operational-first: gate on measurable telemetry and automated evidence collection. The playbook will be reviewed each release window and versioned; any control changes that affect auditability must be blocked until evidence automation passes the acceptance criteria.
